name: Summer Swim Aide (City of Honolulu pools and ocean sites)
org: City and County of Honolulu Department of Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Lifeguards at city pools or ocean sites teach swim classes and keep swimmers safe. They also help run swim, paddle, surf and dive activities.
who_can_apply: Open to applicants as young as 16. You need a valid American Red Cross Lifeguard Training, First Aid and CPR/AED for the Professional Rescuer certificate. You also need work with children and teens.
duration: Seasonal full-time or part-time. The page does not give start or end dates.
deadline_text: The page says applications are accepted online with no closing date listed. Current status not confirmed.
how_to_apply: Apply through the online application link on the Summer Fun Jobs page.
notes: Work sites: 21 pools and 3 ocean recreation sites. Hawaii requires a child labor certificate (work permit) for working minors under 18. It is free. It is a Certificate of Employment for 14 and 15, and a Certificate of Age for 16 and 17.
